note: Offline model files for the iOS app. Used by scripts/fetch_ios_models.sh and scripts/push_ios.sh. Sizes and SHA-256 are from the Hugging Face tree API (LFS oid), 2026-11-21. Must match EngineProfile in MinistralKit/DeviceProfile.swift.

files.untested: unsloth LM with the ggml-org projector is an untested pairing (DESIGN_IPHONE17.md)

12GB.examples: iPhone 17 Pro / Pro Max / Air, iPhone 18 Pro

speech.stt: SFSpeechRecognizer, en-GB, requiresOnDeviceRecognition = true (no file to copy; the OS downloads the en-GB on-device model when Dictation is enabled, which needs internet once)
speech.tts: AVSpeechSynthesizer, en-GB voice (download an Enhanced voice in Settings > Accessibility > Spoken Content > Voices before going offline)
